content.title: 'Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair' release time: Where to watch the reboot, who's returning to the cast and more
content.text: After nearly 20 years, Malcolm is getting back into the middle of things… Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair finds Malcolm all grown up, desperately trying to avoid his family to maintain his calm adult life. Bryan Cranston, Frankie Muniz, Jane Kaczmarek, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Justin Berfield, Emy Coligado, and Craig Lamar Traylor are all returning to the four-episode limited series reboot of Malcolm in the Middle. Here’s everything you need to know about the revival of the beloved 2000s sitcom.Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair trailer: When does the Malcolm in the Middle reboot come out? Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair premieres Friday, April 10, 2026. New series/episodes on Hulu are typically released at 3 a.m. ET/12 a.m. PT.What channel is Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair on? The new Malcolm in the Middle limited series is exclusive to Hulu (and Hulu on Disney+ for bundle subscribers).Where to watch Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still UnfairWho is returning from the Malcolm in the Middle original cast? Frankie Muniz (Malcolm)Bryan Cranston (Hal)Jane Kaczmarek (Lois)Justin Berfield (Reese)Christopher Masterson (Francis)Who is not coming back for the Malcolm in the Middle reboot? Erik Per Sullivan, the original actor who portrayed Dewey, will not be returning to the series. In the reboot, Dewey is played by Caleb Ellsworth-Clark.Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair new cast: Caleb Ellsworth-Clark (Dewey)Anthony Timpano (Jamie)Vaughan Murrae (Kelly)Keeley Karsten (Malcolm’s daughter, Leah)Kiana MadeiraHow many episodes will the Malcolm in the Middle reboot have? The Malcolm in the Middle reboot is a four-part limited series. All four episodes will drop together on Friday, April 10.Where to watch Malcolm in the Middle: All 151 episodes of Malcolm in the Middle are available to stream on Hulu or via Hulu on Disney+ (for bundle subscribers).
